features.name: tx_count
features.desc: Total number of transactions

features.name: log_amount_received_total
features.desc: log10(1 + total amount received)

features.name: log_amount_sent_total
features.desc: log10(1 + total amount sent)

features.name: unique_senders
features.desc: Unique counterparties that sent funds

features.name: unique_receivers
features.desc: Unique counterparties that received funds

features.name: log_max_amount
features.desc: log10(1 + largest single transaction)

features.name: avg_holding_min
features.desc: log10(1 + mean receive->send gap in minutes)

features.name: median_holding_min
features.desc: log10(1 + median receive->send gap in minutes)

features.name: forwarding_ratio
features.desc: total sent / total received (clipped 0..100)

features.name: activity_frequency
features.desc: transactions per active day

features.name: fan_in_ratio
features.desc: unique senders / received count

features.name: fan_out_ratio
features.desc: unique receivers / sent count

features.name: velocity_24h
features.desc: max tx in any 24h window / total tx

features.name: vasp_proximity
features.desc: 1 if a direct counterparty is a known VASP, else 3 (clipped)

features.name: mixer_interaction
features.desc: 1 if any counterparty is a known mixer

features.name: bridge_interaction
features.desc: 1 if any counterparty is a known bridge contract

features.name: sanctioned_match
features.desc: 1 if wallet or counterparty matches a sanctioned list

features.name: distance_from_report
features.desc: hop distance from the reported suspect wallet (0 = suspect)

features.name: rapid_forwarding_count
features.desc: receive->send events within 30 minutes

features.name: fund_split_count
features.desc: fan-out events (3+ unique receivers in 10 min)

features.name: fund_merge_count
features.desc: fan-in events (3+ unique senders in 10 min)

features.name: min_receive_send_gap_min
features.desc: log10(1 + minimum receive->send gap in minutes)

features.name: cross_chain_count
features.desc: transactions touching more than one chain

features.name: wallet_age_days
features.desc: log10(1 + days between first seen and assessment)

features.name: amount_concentration
features.desc: max amount / (median amount + 1) — peel-chain signal

split.method: by case_id, ordered chronologically by first_seen (wallet/case/time)

label_definition: 1 = wallet participates in a known fraud-flow pattern (synthetic, clearly labeled); 0 = legitimate behavior
usage_limits: AI output is prioritization, not a verdict (RULES §0.3).
Every prediction ships with SHAP explanation + model version + model hash (condition 5.4).
